decision_stage: before pilot confound inspection and before all new PID outcomes
nonsteady_state_rule: trim at least 8 volumes, extending through a longer leading contiguous flagged prefix; unexpected later/non-prefix flags require review
displacement_reference: first retained volume; maximum absolute displacement on any individual axis
dvars_role: diagnostic, not an automatic primary exclusion
threshold_boundaries: equal to limit passes; high FD means strictly greater than 0.5 mm
scope: motion and file-completeness gate only; separate visual anatomy and atlas-coverage release required
rationale: Preserve uninterrupted time for lagged PhiID and HRF, add explicit low-motion screening to the legacy displacement rule. These are declared study choices, not universal thresholds or a retroactive claim about existing cohorts.
